Yes. On 16 June the plant exceeded the 1250 kW contract limit twice, both in the 08:00–08:15 window, peaking at 1324.4 kW at 08:15 — 6% over contract [data: get_demand]. This is the Monday-morning simultaneous-start scenario (S2) [data: get_plant_overview].

According to SOP-02 and EQ-01:

**Why OFF, not standby:** A reflow oven in standby draws 36% of its 70 kW rating = 25.2 kW, for as long as it stays on — a large idle load that produces nothing. A switched-off oven uses only about 340–350 kWh per oven-weekend. So standby wastes far more energy than a full cool-down and re-heat. [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby]

**S5 excess energy:** In incident S5 (2025-10-17 to 2025-10-20), RF-02 was left in standby all weekend: about 1,556 kWh versus about 346 kWh normal, an excess of about 1,210 kWh from a single oven. [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby]

Note: the off-schedule rule only flags this after 120 minutes above 20% of rating, so the real benefit of switching off is prevention. [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby]

answer:
Per SOP-03 (Step 2: shed in playbook order), the first load shed is **EV charging (EV-01, 100% of its load)** [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-03_demand_exceedance_response.md#SOP-03 Demand Exceedance Response > Step 2: shed in playbook order].

Loads that must never be shed: the **server room, molders running mid-cycle, and reflow ovens with boards inside** [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-03_demand_exceedance_response.md#SOP-03 Demand Exceedance Response > Step 2: shed in playbook order].

The full shed order is: (1) pause EV charging, (2) delay next burn-in loading (BI-01, BI-02), (3) raise chilled-water setpoint +1°C (CH-01, CH-02), (4) lower compressed-air pressure 0.5 bar (AC-01–03) [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-03_demand_exceedance_response.md#SOP-03 Demand Exceedance Response > Step 2: shed in playbook order].
